text:
Sam Carter: Quick check — we're ~2h from docs deploy cutoff. Need a final pass on console copy + SDK docs regen. Anyone blocking?

Priya Nair: PR #3421 bumped SDK to v1.8.0, changelog entry in the PR body. Merge-ready once CI is green.

Miguel Alvarez: CI failed lint on /docs/reference/auth.md (line ~88). I'll push a tiny formatting fix.

Sam Carter: Thanks — also can you add a one-line note about the auth redirect behavior in the changelog? It's small but customer-facing.

Miguel Alvarez: Yep. Pushing PR #3422 with the lint fix + changelog line. ETA ~20m.

Jordan Lee: I can run the staging smoke once regen finishes. Ping me when the docs build completes.

docs-bot: SDK docs regen job queued for tag v1.8.0 — job id sdk-regen-778.

Priya Nair: PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/pr/3421 — CI shows 1 flaky integration test unrelated to docs. Lint is the gate here.

Miguel Alvarez: Fix pushed, test lint now passes locally. Retrying CI.

Sam Carter: Reminder on branching: target release/1.8.x for changelog and release-notes PRs (do not target main). We'll cherry-pick anything urgent later.

Priya Nair: Done — retargeted #3421 to release/1.8.x.

deploy-bot: Docs staging deploy scheduled for 2026-03-18T02:00Z (15m window). Will follow up with deploy URL when live.

Sam Carter: Local commands if you want to run regen/build: 
```
yarn install
yarn docs:build
./scripts/regenerate-sdk-docs.sh v1.8.0
```

Jordan Lee: Staging smoke link (will post once deploy finishes). Checklist I'll run: top nav, search, SDK reference samples, console walkthrough.

Jordan Lee: Quick note — found one missing redirect from /console/auth -> /console/authn. Adding redirect rule in content repo now.

Sam Carter: If anything blocks in the next 30m, call it out here. Otherwise plan: merge changelog PRs -> wait for sdk-regen job -> run staging smoke -> tag v1.8.0 and cut release branch. :thumbsup:

Miguel Alvarez: :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: :rocket:
